topic: China's share of world gallium production
disagreement: USITC briefing says China produced 'close to 90 percent' of world gallium in 2022; USGS MCS 2026 says China accounted for 99% of world primary low-purity gallium production.
possible_reasons: different population (all gallium vs primary low-purity gallium)
USITC figure cites press reports (Al Jazeera, Reuters), not USGS statistics
rationale: USGS is the official statistical source for mineral production; the USITC executive briefing is an author's view citing news reports in footnote 2.
remaining_uncertainty: USGS figure for 2022 itself was not read this run, so how much is period change vs. source quality is unclear.
